name: YOSHIROTTEN
introduction: The Tokyo-based graphic artist and art designer Yoshirotten boasts global clients, supplying a wide scope of designs and collaboration merchandises for fashion brands, musicians, and corporations. In 2013, GAS AS INTERFACE CO.,LTD.  published the book of his works GASBOOK 28 YOSHIROTTEN. He worked on the key visuals for 2014-15 Mercedez-Benz Fashion Week Tokyo. His exhibitions extended as far as Berlin and London.
